name: measuretwice-workspace
description: Development workspace for measuretwice: Rust core, Node binding, and public TypeScript package.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:native: napi build --platform -p measuretwice-node --package-json-path crates/measuretwice-node/package.json && node scripts/copy-binding.mjs
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:rs && npm run test:ts
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/measuretwice/dist packages/measuretwice/binding.cjs packages/measuretwice/binding.d.cts packages/measuretwice/*.node packages/measuretwice/schemas crates/measuretwice-node/index.js crates/measuretwice-node/index.d.ts crates/measuretwice-node/*.node crates/measuretwice-node/npm build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:rs && npm run test:ts
